name: ZhangLS.Spec.CoprimeProfileAbel.principal_LSeries
source_signature:
lemma principal_LSeries {D : ℕ} (hD : D ≠ 0) {s : ℂ} (hs : 1 < s.re) :
    LSeries (fun n : ℕ => (1 : DirichletCharacter ℂ D) (n : ZMod D)) s =

source_signature:
lemma total_density_eq_main {D : ℕ} (hD : 0 < D) :

name: ZhangLS.Spec.CoprimeProfileAbel.summatory_zero_start

lemma summatory_zero_start (D : ℕ) (x : ℝ) :

name: ZhangLS.Spec.CoprimeProfileAbel.finite_abel
source_signature:
theorem finite_abel (D : ℕ) {L R : ℝ} (hL : 0 ≤ L) (hLR : L ≤ R)
    (f f' : ℝ → ℝ) (hf : ∀ t ∈ Set.Icc L R, HasDerivAt f (f' t) t)
    (hf' : ContinuousOn f' (Set.Icc L R)) :
    (∑ n ∈ Finset.Ioc ⌊L⌋₊ ⌊R⌋₊, f n * coefficient D n) =
      f R * summatory D R - f L * summatory D L -
        ∫ t in L..R, f' t * summatory D t

name: ZhangLS.Spec.CoprimeProfileAbel.summatory_product_integrable
source_signature:
lemma summatory_product_integrable (D : ℕ) {L R : ℝ} (hL : 0 ≤ L) (hLR : L ≤ R)
    {g : ℝ → ℝ} (hg : ContinuousOn g (Set.Icc L R)) :
    IntervalIntegrable (fun t => g t * summatory D t) volume L R

name: ZhangLS.Spec.CoprimeProfileAbel.abel_remainder_identity
source_signature:
theorem abel_remainder_identity (D : ℕ) {L R : ℝ} (hL : 0 ≤ L) (hLR : L ≤ R)
    (f f' : ℝ → ℝ) (hf : ∀ t ∈ Set.Icc L R, HasDerivAt f (f' t) t)
    (hf' : ContinuousOn f' (Set.Icc L R)) (hfL : f L = 0) (hfR : f R = 0) :
    (∑ n ∈ Finset.Ioc ⌊L⌋₊ ⌊R⌋₊, f n * coefficient D n) -
      mainConstant D * (∫ t in L..R, f t) =
      -(∫ t in L..R, f' t * (summatory D t - mainConstant D * t))

name: ZhangLS.Spec.CoprimeProfileAbel.abel_remainder_bound
source_signature:
theorem abel_remainder_bound {D : ℕ} (hD : 0 < D) {L R W : ℝ}
    (hL : 1 ≤ L) (hLR : L ≤ R) (hW : 0 ≤ W)
    (f f' : ℝ → ℝ) (hf : ∀ t ∈ Set.Icc L R, HasDerivAt f (f' t) t)
    (hf' : ContinuousOn f' (Set.Icc L R)) (hfL : f L = 0) (hfR : f R = 0)
    (hbound : ∀ t ∈ Set.Icc L R, |f' t| ≤ W / t ^ 2) :
    |(∑ n ∈ Finset.Ioc ⌊L⌋₊ ⌊R⌋₊, f n * coefficient D n) -
      mainConstant D * (∫ t in L..R, f t)| ≤
      ((D.divisors.card : ℝ) * (1 + Real.log R) + 2) * W / L

source_signature:
lemma profileWeight_integral (K K' : ℝ → ℝ) (hK : ∀ u, HasDerivAt K (K' u) u)
    {a b B : ℝ} (hB : 0 < B) (hab : a ≤ b) :
    (∫ t in Real.exp (a * B)..Real.exp (b * B), profileWeight K B t) =

name: ZhangLS.Spec.CoprimeProfileAbel.weighted_term_eq
source_signature:
lemma weighted_term_eq (D n : ℕ) (K : ℝ → ℝ) (B : ℝ) :
    (if n.Coprime D then (n.totient : ℝ) / (n : ℝ) ^ 2 else 0) * K (Real.log n / B) =
      profileWeight K B n * coefficient D n

name: ZhangLS.Spec.CoprimeProfileAbel.weightedProfileSum_eq_interval

lemma weightedProfileSum_eq_interval (D : ℕ) (K : ℝ → ℝ) {a b B : ℝ}
    (hB : 0 < B) (hsupport : Function.support K ⊆ Set.Icc a b) (hKa : K a = 0) :
    weightedProfileSum D K B b =
      ∑ n ∈ Finset.Ioc ⌊Real.exp (a * B)⌋₊ ⌊Real.exp (b * B)⌋₊,
        profileWeight K B n * coefficient D n

name: ZhangLS.Spec.CoprimeProfileAbel.weighted_abel_identity
source_signature:
theorem weighted_abel_identity {D : ℕ} (K K' : ℝ → ℝ) {a b B : ℝ}
    (hB : 0 < B) (hab : a ≤ b)
    (hK : ∀ u, HasDerivAt K (K' u) u) (hK' : Continuous K')
    (hsupport : Function.support K ⊆ Set.Icc a b) :
    weightedProfileSum D K B b - mainConstant D * B * (∫ u in a..b, K u) =
      -(∫ t in Real.exp (a * B)..Real.exp (b * B),
        profileWeightDeriv K K' B t * (summatory D t - mainConstant D * t))

name: ZhangLS.Spec.CoprimeProfileAbel.weighted_abel_error
source_signature:
theorem weighted_abel_error {D : ℕ} (hD : 0 < D) (K K' : ℝ → ℝ)
    {a b B M0 M1 : ℝ} (ha : 0 ≤ a) (hab : a ≤ b) (hB : 0 < B)
    (hM0 : 0 ≤ M0) (hM1 : 0 ≤ M1)
    (hK : ∀ u, HasDerivAt K (K' u) u) (hK' : Continuous K')
    (hsupport : Function.support K ⊆ Set.Icc a b)
    (hbound0 : ∀ u ∈ Set.Icc a b, |K u| ≤ M0)
    (hbound1 : ∀ u ∈ Set.Icc a b, |K' u| ≤ M1) :
    |weightedProfileSum D K B b - mainConstant D * B * (∫ u in a..b, K u)| ≤
      ((D.divisors.card : ℝ) * (1 + b * B) + 2) *
        (M0 + M1 / B) / Real.exp (a * B)

name: ZhangLS.Spec.CoprimeProfileAbel.original_window_abel_error
source_signature:
theorem original_window_abel_error {D : ℕ} (hD : 0 < D) (K K' : ℝ → ℝ)
    {P M0 M1 : ℝ} (hP : 1 < P) (hM0 : 0 ≤ M0) (hM1 : 0 ≤ M1)
    (hK : ∀ u, HasDerivAt K (K' u) u) (hK' : Continuous K')
    (hsupport : Function.support K ⊆ Set.Icc (251 / 500 : ℝ) (201 / 400))
    (hbound0 : ∀ u ∈ Set.Icc (251 / 500 : ℝ) (201 / 400), |K u| ≤ M0)
    (hbound1 : ∀ u ∈ Set.Icc (251 / 500 : ℝ) (201 / 400), |K' u| ≤ M1) :
    |weightedProfileSum D K (Real.log P) (201 / 400) -
      mainConstant D * Real.log P * (∫ u in (251 / 500 : ℝ)..(201 / 400), K u)| ≤
      ((D.divisors.card : ℝ) * (1 + (201 / 400) * Real.log P) + 2) *
        (M0 + M1 / Real.log P) / Real.exp ((251 / 500) * Real.log P)

name: ZhangLS.Spec.FixedHDiagonal.paper_diagonal
source_signature:
theorem paper_diagonal {D : ℕ} (hD : 2 ≤ D) (c : ℝ) (j : Fin 3)
    {f f' : ℝ → ℝ} {a b : ℝ} (hf : Continuous f) (hf' : Continuous f')
    (hd : ∀ x, HasDerivAt f (f' x) x) (ha : f a = 0) :
    (∫ x in a..b, (F D c j f f' x * G D c j f f' b x).re) =
      (∫ x in a..b, (f' x)^2) +
      Real.pi^2 * (11-26*delta D c-(delta D c)^2) * (∫ x in a..b, (f x)^2)

name: ZhangLS.Spec.FixedHDiagonal.paper_diagonal_c2

theorem paper_diagonal_c2 {D : ℕ} (hD : 2 ≤ D) (c : ℝ) (j : Fin 3)
    {f : ℝ → ℝ} {a b : ℝ} (hf : ContDiff ℝ 2 f)
    (_hs : HasCompactSupport f) (ha : f a = 0) (_hb : f b = 0) :
    (∫ x in a..b, (F D c j f (deriv f) x * G D c j f (deriv f) b x).re) =
      (∫ x in a..b, (deriv f x)^2) +
      Real.pi^2 * (11-26*delta D c-(delta D c)^2) * (∫ x in a..b, (f x)^2)

name: ZhangLS.Spec.FixedHDiagonal.pure_imaginary_product
source_signature:
lemma pure_imaginary_product (u v w p t h : ℝ) :
    ((-(p : ℂ) - (I * (u : ℂ)) * (t : ℂ)) *
      (-(p : ℂ) + (I*(v : ℂ) + I*(w : ℂ)) * (t : ℂ) +
        ((I*(v : ℂ))*(I*(w : ℂ))) * (h : ℂ))).re =
      p^2 + u*(v+w)*t^2 + v*w*p*h

name: ZhangLS.Spec.FixedHDiagonal.cyclic_coefficient
source_signature:
lemma cyclic_coefficient (δ : ℝ) (j : Fin 3) :
    let q : Fin 3 → ℝ := fun k => if k = 0 then 1-5*δ else
      if k = 1 then 2*(1+δ) else 3*(1-δ)
    q j * (q (j+1) + q (j+2)) + q (j+1) * q (j+2) = 11-26*δ-δ^2

name: ZhangLS.Spec.FixedHDiagonal.scaled_diagonal
source_signature:
theorem scaled_diagonal {f f' : ℝ → ℝ} {a b : ℝ}
    (hf : Continuous f) (hf' : Continuous f')
    (hd : ∀ x, HasDerivAt f (f' x) x) (ha : f a = 0)
    (δ : ℝ) (j : Fin 3) :
